spec.description: The earthquakes of 24 June 2026 in Venezuela through OpenStreetMap: day by day, the buildings volunteers added in Caracas and La Guaira (from 51,000 to more than 170,000 in three weeks) on an H3 map, the hours they worked, and a curtain between Vantor's before and after imagery with HOT's validated damage.

options.content:
### About the data

- **OpenStreetMap**: every building (a way tagged `building=*`) added to or deleted from the box, from the full history
  through the [ohsome API](https://api.ohsome.org) (HeiGIT), whose history ends on 27 July 2026. © OpenStreetMap
  contributors, ODbL. A building is placed at its centroid and counted in its H3 cell of resolution 9.
- **Imagery**: [Vantor (Maxar) Open Data](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/vantor-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/events/Venezuela-Earthquake-Jun-2026/collection.json),
  pre- and post-event, CC BY-NC 4.0, read as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs by Pacha's tile server.
- **Damage**: HOT's [building damage assessment](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/venezuela-m-7-5-earthquake-building-damage-assessment):
  AI-detected damage on the imagery, accepted by MapSwipe volunteers, and field reports. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
- The activation: [OSM wiki](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Humanitarian_OSM_Team/Open_Mapping_Hub_-_Latin_America_and_The_Caribbean/Activations/2026_Venezuela_Earthquake).

Built by `datasets/venezuela-eq-2026/build.sh` in pacha-dashboards. Times are UTC unless they say Caracas.

spec.rawSql:
-- Each H3 cell on the last day of the timeline window: the buildings OpenStreetMap had (those of 1 June,
-- plus those added, less those deleted, up to then) and the share of them added in the window and in the hours and
-- area the filters keep. The area drawn on this map is left out here, so the map keeps every cell.
WITH w AS (
  SELECT hex,
         sum(delta) FILTER (WHERE t <= coalesce(try_cast($tTo AS TIMESTAMP), 'infinity'::TIMESTAMP)) AS net,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'creation' AND $__crossfilter($osmFilters, -area)) AS added
  FROM $changes GROUP BY hex
)
SELECT hex, (coalesce(c.before, 0) + coalesce(w.net, 0))::INTEGER AS buildings, coalesce(c.before, 0)::INTEGER AS on_1_june,
       coalesce(w.added, 0)::INTEGER AS added,
       -- a building redrawn (deleted and added again) counts as added: the share stops at 100
       least(100, round(100.0 * coalesce(w.added, 0) / greatest(coalesce(c.before, 0) + coalesce(w.net, 0), 1), 1)) AS added_pct
FROM $cells AS c FULL JOIN w USING (hex)
WHERE coalesce(c.before, 0) + coalesce(w.net, 0) > 0

spec.description: Each hexagon is an H3 cell of about 0.09 km². Its height is the buildings OpenStreetMap had there on the last day of the timeline window; its colour, the share of them added in the window (and in the hours and area kept). Play the timeline to watch the volunteers map.
spec.title: OpenStreetMap buildings per H3 cell (0.09 km²)

spec.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT sum(before) FROM $cells) + (SELECT sum(delta) FROM $changes WHERE t <= coalesce(try_cast($tTo AS TIMESTAMP), 'infinity'::TIMESTAMP)))::BIGINT AS "Buildings"

spec.description: The buildings OpenStreetMap had in the box on the last day of the timeline window.

options.content:
## Mapping a city after an earthquake

On **24 June 2026** two earthquakes struck northern Venezuela; Caracas and La Guaira were among the hardest hit.
Within hours the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) opened mapping projects, and volunteers around the world began
tracing every roof in the satellite imagery, so that rescuers and planners had a map of what was there.

On 1 June, OpenStreetMap had **about 51,000 buildings** here, mapped since 2010. Three weeks after the earthquakes
it had **more than 170,000**.

Play the timeline below, drag over the hours to see when the volunteers worked, or draw an area on the map.

## Before and after

**Drag the curtain.** Left of it, Vantor (Maxar) imagery from before the earthquakes; right of it, the same coast a few
days after, with the areas where an AI saw damage and **MapSwipe volunteers agreed** (red) and the collapses reported
on the ground (white rings).

The map opens on **Caraballeda** (before: 3 November 2025; after: 26 June). Pan west along the coast to **Catia La
Mar and Maiquetía** (before: 7 April; after: 27 June): those two were taken from very different angles (35° and 15° off
vertical), so they do not line up exactly and buildings jump across the curtain.

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: every building OpenStreetMap gained or lost in the box (Caracas, El Junquito, Catia La Mar,
-- La Guaira, Caraballeda, Naiguatá) from 1 June to 27 July 2026, where ohsome's history ends: its time,
-- +1 or -1, its H3 cell (resolution 9, about 0.09 km²), its centroid, its changeset and the hour in
-- Caracas (UTC-4) it was made. From the full history through the ohsome API (datasets/venezuela-eq-2026).
SELECT time AS t, kind, CASE kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS delta, hex, latitude, longitude, changeset,
       (hour(time) + 20) % 24 AS hr
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/venezuela-eq-2026/osm_changes.parquet')
WHERE time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'

spec.description: Buildings per H3 cell in OpenStreetMap on 1 June 2026.
spec.label: Cells
spec.name: cells

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: the buildings each H3 cell had in OpenStreetMap on 1 June 2026, before the earthquakes
-- (every building added since October 2007 less those deleted), and when its first one was mapped.
SELECT hex, sum(CASE kind WHEN 'creation' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)::INTEGER AS before, min(time) AS first_mapped
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/venezuela-eq-2026/osm_changes.parquet')
WHERE time < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY hex

spec.description: Buildings added to OpenStreetMap in the box, year by year.
spec.label: Years
spec.name: years

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: buildings added to OpenStreetMap in the box, by period since the first one (2010), with
-- 2026 split at the earthquakes (24 June): what took years against what took weeks.
SELECT CASE WHEN time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-24' THEN '24 June – 27 July 2026'
            WHEN year(time) = 2026 THEN '2026 to 23 June'
            WHEN year(time) >= 2019 THEN '2019–2025'
            WHEN year(time) = 2018 THEN 'In 2018'
            ELSE '2010–2017' END AS period,
       min(time) AS since, count(*) AS added
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/venezuela-eq-2026/osm_changes.parquet')
WHERE kind = 'creation'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY since

spec.description: HOT's validated damage cells and field reports.
spec.label: Damage
spec.name: damage

query.rawSql:
-- Server side: HOT's building damage areas, H3 cells of about 1,800 m² that an AI found damaged on the
-- before and after imagery and that MapSwipe volunteers accepted, with their votes; and the damage HOT's
-- volunteers reported on the ground (ChatMap). HDX, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
SELECT 'cell' AS source, area, damaged_votes, validators, damaged_share, NULL AS level, NULL AS name, latitude, longitude, geojson
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/venezuela-eq-2026/damage_cells.parquet')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'field', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, level, name, latitude, longitude, NULL
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/venezuela-eq-2026/damage_points.parquet')
